nodes.title: SG-8.4 Robust, visible contribution history loading
nodes.body:
Context: ContributionSheet (game/frontend/src/components/ContributionSheet.tsx) calls listMine(roundId) on open and silently swallows failures, so players see nothing while loading and nothing on error. Desired behavior: the history list shows explicit loading, empty and error-with-retry states, and the remaining count is derived from the loaded history. Why: players must understand what the history area is doing and recover from failures.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the sheet is open and listMine is pending, when it renders, then a loading message is shown in the history area
- Given listMine resolves with an empty list, when it renders, then an empty-state message is shown and Contributions left equals MAX_PER_PLAYER
- Given listMine rejects, when it renders, then an error message and a Retry button are shown, and clicking Retry calls listMine again
- Given listMine resolves with N sent items, when it renders, then Contributions left equals MAX_PER_PLAYER minus N


## Scope
- In scope: History states in ContributionSheet.tsx
- Out of scope: Backend changes
- Out of scope: Changes to submit validation or quota rules
- Preserve: Existing submit flow, validation messages and Radix dialog behavior
- Preserve: listMine API contract


## Technical constraints
- Use the real listMine client; no mock data in product code
- Remaining stays derived from entries, not a separate counter


## Definition of done
- All three requirements implemented and unit tested
- Existing contribution tests still pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · History list shows a loading state and remaining is derived from history
nodes.body:
Context: no loading indicator exists while listMine is in flight. Desired behavior: a status message 'Loading your suggestions…' shows until listMine settles, after which the list and the remaining count (MAX_PER_PLAYER minus sent entries) render. Why: the player knows history is being fetched.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine is pending, when the sheet opens, then an element with role status and text 'Loading your suggestions…' is visible
- Given listMine resolves with 2 contributions, when loading ends, then the loading text is gone, both prompts are listed and 'Contributions left: 3' shows


## Scope
- In scope: historyStatus state and loading render
- Out of scope: Empty and error states
- Preserve: Merge of history with in-flight entries


## Technical constraints
- Remaining remains computed from entries


## Definition of done
- Loading state renders and clears


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · History list shows an empty state when the player has no suggestions
nodes.body:
Context: an empty history currently renders a blank list. Desired behavior: after listMine resolves with no items and no local entries exist, show 'No suggestions yet this round'. Why: distinguishes empty from loading or broken.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine resolves with [], when loading ends, then 'No suggestions yet this round' is visible and 'Contributions left: 5' shows
- Given the empty state is shown, when the player submits a suggestion, then the empty message disappears and the entry is listed


## Scope
- In scope: Empty-state render
- Out of scope: Loading and error states
- Preserve: Submit flow


## Definition of done
- Empty state renders only when ready and entries empty


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · History load failure shows an explained error with Retry
nodes.body:
Context: the catch in the history effect is empty so failures are invisible. Desired behavior: on rejection show 'Could not load your suggestions' (role alert) and a Retry button that re-runs listMine and returns to loading, then ready. Why: players can recover without closing the sheet.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given listMine rejects, when loading ends, then role alert text 'Could not load your suggestions' and a button named Retry are visible
- Given the error state, when Retry is clicked and listMine then resolves, then listMine was called twice and the history list renders without the error


## Scope
- In scope: Error state and Retry
- Out of scope: Automatic retry or backoff
- Preserve: Submit still works when history failed


## Technical constraints
- Retry re-triggers the existing effect via a reload counter


## Definition of done
- Error and Retry work


## Clarifying questions
- None
